title: OpenClaw Provider Auth: models.json ↔ auth-profiles.json Must Stay in Sync
description: Menambahkan provider baru ke models.json tanpa entry di auth-profiles.json menyebabkan auth error saat provider lain rate-limited. Meski endpoint tidak butuh auth (IP whitelisted), OpenClaw tetap butuh entry auth-profiles.json — bisa pakai dummy apiKey.
solution: Checklist: (1) Tambah provider ke models.json, (2) WAJIB tambah entry auth di auth-profiles.json, (3) Gateway restart. Tanpa step 2, fallback chain terputus.

title: GitHub Fine-grained PAT Limitations: No User-Level Permissions
description: Fine-grained PAT GitHub scope-nya per-repository, tidak support user-level permissions (read:user, user:email, read:org). Untuk operasi yang butuh user + repo access sekaligus (gh CLI, OVERSOUL push), classic PAT tetap diperlukan.
solution: Classic PAT untuk operasi user-level (gh CLI, OVERSOUL). Fine-grained PAT untuk repo-only operations di org tertentu (griyayatim, seatrax). Pisahkan sesuai kebutuhan scope.

title: GitHub Copilot API — 40+ Models Discovery
description: OpenClaw auto-discover hanya 2 model. Manual query ke /models endpoint ungkap 40+ model. Primary switched to claude-opus-4.6.
solution: Always check API model list manually.

title: GitHub PAT Protocol — Multi-Account Token Switching
description: gh CLI default = dekirulab PAT. Operasi ke hadyandev/* repos WAJIB switch PAT dulu. Git remote non-interactive: x-access-token URL format.
solution: Check gh auth status before push. Use x-access-token URL.

title: Verify Before Act — SoM is Hint, Not Truth
description: Memory/SoM = hint, bukan source of truth. Sebelum bertindak: (1) memory_recall → context, (2) verify via actual check (exec/API/read), (3) baru act. Anti-pattern: PAT terbalik, repo state salah karena asumsi dari memory lama.
solution: Protocol 3-step: Recall → Verify → Act. Berlaku semua sesi tanpa pengecualian.

title: Spirit of Fortress — IaC Backup Pattern
description: SoF = IaC backup repo hadyandev/fortress. Caddy 13 sites, 28 containers, OS config, bootstrap + health-check scripts, RESTORE.md runbook. Trigger: setiap config change di Fortress → Mustang commit push.

title: Mihrab Input Bug: Date Field adalah Title Type, bukan Date Type
description: Mihrab (Riyadhah Al-Qalb) entries selama ini null karena format input salah. Field 'Date' di mihrab DB adalah title type (string), BUKAN date type. Harus diisi sebagai title, contoh: 'Senin, 20 Maret 2026 / 30 Ramadhan 1447H'.
solution: Gunakan template yang sudah dikunci di AGENTS.md. Jangan assume field types tanpa verifikasi. Historical entries perlu backfill manual.

title: Notion API Version: 2022-06-28 adalah versi yang bekerja untuk semua ops

solution: Hardcode 'Notion-Version: 2022-06-28' di semua API calls. Versi ini adalah stable dan supported.

title: Ghost Memory — Tiga Layer Harus Sinkron, Bukan Cukup Satu

Fix: audit field types eksplisit, buat input template per DB, Live Session Capture tanpa tunggu cron. Tiga layer wajib sinkron: SoM (LTM) + Sibyl (workspace files) + Grimoire (Notion).

description: Setup OpenCode dengan multiple agents: @make (Edward — implementor, executes code changes), @check (reviewer, validates logic), @test (Pest TDD, runs tests). Config: OpenRouter sebagai LLM backend + GitHub MCP server + GitNexus MCP. Agents didefinisikan di opencode.json dengan instructions berbeda per role.

title: GitHub Fine-Grained PAT Scoping
description: Classic PAT dengan scope write:issues tidak berlaku untuk org repos yang memerlukan fine-grained token. Untuk membuat/update GitHub Issues via API di organisasi, diperlukan fine-grained PAT dengan permission: Issues (Read & Write) + repository access ke specific repos atau semua org repos.
solution: GitHub Settings → Developer Settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token. Set: Resource owner = dekirulab org, Repository access = specific repos, Permissions: Issues → Read and write.

title: RustFS: Correct Env Variables
description: RustFS tidak menggunakan ROOT_USER/ROOT_PASSWORD seperti MinIO. Env vars yang benar: RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY (access key), RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY (secret key), CONSOLE_ENABLE=true (untuk web console). Kesalahan env vars menyebabkan authentication failure pada S3-compatible storage.
solution: Ganti ROOT_USER → RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY, ROOT_PASSWORD → RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY, tambah CONSOLE_ENABLE=true. Update juga env AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY pada queue worker yang mengakses RustFS.

title: Filament v5 Namespace & Custom Page Gotchas
description: Critical Filament v5 lessons from Angkain Sprint 7: (1) Grid::make(2) tidak ada — gunakan ->columns(N). (2) Get/Set → Filament\Schemas\Components\Utilities\Get/Set. (3) Section → Filament\Schemas\Components\Section. (4) Custom Page: $view & getTitle() harus NON-static. (5) Tailwind di custom blade di-purge — pakai inline style atau x-filament::* native components. (6) Docker build cache bisa stuck — bust dengan touch dummy file.

title: Komunita: communitiesInScope() is instance method — use Community::descendantIds() static
description: communitiesInScope() is an instance method on HierarchicalScoping trait — cannot be called statically. For static context (e.g. query scopes), use Community::descendantIds() instead.
solution: Replace static calls to communitiesInScope() with Community::descendantIds() in query builders.

title: Matrix member linking: username column = @user:matrix.server
description: To link Matrix users to app members: store Matrix user ID (@user:server) in username column of members table. Bot looks up member by username to identify sender.
solution: Member::where('username', $matrixUserId)->first(). Unique constraint on username. Migration: add_unique_username_members.php

title: baibot/Matrix: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for Laravel bots
description: baibot (Matrix bot framework) requires OpenAI-compatible API. Implement POST /api/v1/chat/completions in Laravel with BotChatController. Auth via Bearer token (BOT_API_TOKEN env).
solution: Controller: BotChatController.php. Config: config/bot.php. Routes: routes/api.php registered in bootstrap/app.php as api:. baibot config: base_url, api_key, model fields.

title: Mutabaah grid: auto-save per cell, today-highlight, future-disable pattern
description: Livewire grid component: rows=members, cols=days 1–31. Auto-save on checkbox change (wire:change). Today column highlighted with CSS class. Future days disabled. OK count + % per row.
solution: Use Livewire wire:change event → updateEntry(, ).  = now()->day. Disable if  > . Highlight if  == .

title: Filament v5: $view must be non-static property in Page classes
description: In Filament v5 Page classes, protected string $view must be non-static. Pages generated via shell heredoc may produce syntax errors.
solution: Declare: protected string $view = "path.to.view"; (not static). Use write tool for generating Filament Page files.

title: PostgreSQL Ambiguous Column in JOIN Queries
solution:
Problem: whereIn("id", $ids) in Community.php + HierarchicalScoping.php caused PostgreSQL error when JOINed with user_communities (ambiguous column).
Fix: Qualify with table name → whereIn("communities.id", $ids)
Rule: Always qualify column names when query involves JOINs in PostgreSQL.

title: Filament v5 ThemeMode Correct Namespace
solution:
WRONG: use Filament\Support\Enums\ThemeMode
CORRECT: use Filament\Enums\ThemeMode
Usage: ->defaultThemeMode(ThemeMode::Light)->darkMode(false)

title: Zakat Fitrah Module: generatePayments() Idempotent Pattern
solution:
Design: generatePayments() uses idempotent upsert logic:
1. New family → INSERT (jiwa from family_members count)
2. Exists + nominal NULL → UPDATE jiwa + perkiraan
3. Exists + nominal FILLED → SKIP (protect paid data)
Key: jumlah_jiwa is auto-computed, non-editable → forces user to complete family data first.
ZakatPeriod excludes HierarchicalScoping intentionally (superadmin-only resource).

title: Filament v5 Panel ID Migration (admin → app)
solution:
1. Change panel id in AdminPanelProvider: ->id("app")
2. Change path: ->path("app")
3. Replace ALL hardcoded route("filament.admin.xxx") → use filament()->getCurrentPanel()->getId()
4. Affected files: PeriodeResource.php, ViewPeriode.php, EventResource.php
5. Update Caddy: redir / /app permanent

title: Laravel HTTPS Mixed Content — asset() vs secure_asset()
description: Mixed Content error terjadi karena asset() generate HTTP URLs di halaman HTTPS. secure_asset() auto-generate HTTPS URLs.
solution: Replace ALL asset() with secure_asset() in panel providers. Add URL::forceScheme('https') + URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) unconditionally in AppServiceProvider.

title: SoftDeletes + Filament v5 Resource Integration
description: Tidak ada global setting soft delete di Filament. Harus: (1) trait SoftDeletes di model, (2) migration alter table add deleted_at, (3) TrashedFilter + RestoreAction + ForceDeleteAction di setiap Resource. JurnalEntry dikecualikan karena immutable by PSAK 109.

title: Filament v5 Custom Login Page — Split Layout Architecture
description: Custom login dengan split layout: 60% brand panel kiri + 40% form kanan. Islamic geometric CSS pattern. Mobile responsive.
solution: Extend Filament\Auth\Pages\Login, override $view. Wrapper: x-filament-panels::layout.base. Content: x-filament-panels::page.simple. x-filament-panels::form.actions TIDAK ADA di v5.

title: Filament v5 Login Page — Anatomy & Override
description: Filament v5 Login extends SimplePage. SimplePage punya $layout yang inject .fi-simple-layout wrapper. Untuk full custom login, override $layout ke base di subclass Login + render form via $this->content.
solution: Override static $layout property + buat full custom HTML view. x-filament-panels::form.actions tidak exist di v5 - gunakan content langsung.

title: Filament v5 Panel Architecture Reorg — Single Panel + Gate
description: Menghilangkan SuperAdmin panel terpisah. Semua role akses /app, dengan gate di resource-level untuk super_admin features.
solution: Hapus SuperAdminPanelProvider. Pindah semua resource ke /app. Gate super_admin role via canAccess(). $isScopedToTenant = false untuk global resources.

title: Back-to-Top Button — activeScroller Detection Pattern
description: Filament menggunakan custom scroll container .fi-main-ctn. window.scrollY tidak reliable. Capture phase event listener untuk detect any scrolling element.
solution: Use document.addEventListener('scroll', ..., true) capture phase. Track which element is scrolling as activeScroller. Poll fallback setInterval(updateVisibility, 800). Filament main container: .fi-main-ctn (NOT window).

title: Filament Multi-Tenant: getTenants() harus return non-empty
description: Filament pakai getTenants() untuk initial redirect setelah login. Jika return empty Collection → 404. canAccessTenant() return true tidak cukup. Super_admin harus return semua Cabang aktif di getTenants(), bukan hanya pivot entries.

title: JurnalService — Custom Double-Entry Accounting (Laravel 12)
solution: scottlaurent/accounting incompatible with Laravel 12. Solution: custom JurnalService with auto-journal observers on Penerimaan + Penyaluran (POSTED status). Account mapping: debit by metode_bayar (TUNAI=1-001, else 1-002); credit from kategoriPenerimaan->kode_akun. Journal number format: JRN-YYYYMM-XXXX. akun_perkiraan kode format: 1-001 (NOT 1-1-1).

title: Dokploy Compose Deploy SOP — git pull + stash + API trigger
solution: Komunita composeId: Gre0N0uR0Tg6oK2Mu_fxq | Angkain composeId: rT0VN4ALJFtf8KJ71ZFoQ. Deploy: push to GitHub -> git pull at /etc/dokploy/compose/<id>/code -> POST /api/compose.deploy. If uncommitted changes: git stash first. LOG_CHANNEL=stderr -> errors in docker logs <container>, not storage/logs/laravel.log.

title: Filament v5 — Namespace & Property Gotchas (Complete Compendium)
solution: 1. Actions: Filament\Actions\ (NOT Tables\Actions\). 2. ChartWidget: getType(): string (no $chartType). 3. Page with form: HasForms + InteractsWithForms required. 4. ListRecords plural, others singular. 5. $navigationGroup = ?string only. 6. Blade @endif on own line always.

URL::forceScheme(https) di AppServiceProvider saat APP_ENV=production. 4. title: Stalwart SMTP Auth: Username = Short Name, Password via Web UI Only

solution: 1. Buat akun via Stalwart Web UI (https://mail.dekirulab.id). 2. Gunakan short username saat konfigurasi SMTP client (MAIL_USERNAME=noreply bukan noreply@dekirulab.id). 3. MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS boleh pakai full email.

title: Stalwart v0.15: Hapus [session.auth] dari config.toml — Konflik dengan RocksDB

solution:
1. Hapus [session.auth] block dari config.toml
2. Set via Web UI atau API: auth.directory=internal, auth.mechanisms=plain login
3. Verify: GET /api/settings/list?prefix=auth
4. Restart container setelah perubahan toml

title: Docker Cross-Network: Container Reach Stalwart via Network Connect + Extra Hosts
description: Container di Docker network yang berbeda tidak bisa reach Stalwart via public domain. Perlu dua langkah: (1) join ke Stalwart network dan (2) tambah extra_hosts untuk resolve domain ke IP internal.
solution:
1. docker network connect compose-compress-bluetooth-firewall-6mv4q1_default <container_name>
2. Tambah di compose file:
   extra_hosts:
     - mail.dekirulab.id:10.0.4.2
3. docker compose up -d --force-recreate <service>

title: Stalwart v0.15: Hapus [session.auth] dari config.toml
description: Stalwart v0.15 menyimpan auth settings di RocksDB internal DB, bukan config.toml. Jika [session.auth] ada di toml, terjadi config parse error: 'Invalid variable or constant internal' dan auth gagal silently.
solution: Hapus seluruh [session.auth] block dari config.toml. Auth settings dikelola via DB — cek dengan GET /api/settings/list?prefix=auth. Harus ada: auth.directory=internal, auth.mechanisms=plain login, auth.require=true.

title: Docker Cross-Network: Stalwart + Dependent Containers
description: Container (Roundcube, Invoice Ninja) tidak bisa reach Stalwart via public domain/IP karena Docker network isolation. SSL cert juga tidak match jika pakai IP langsung.
solution: 2 langkah wajib: (1) docker network connect compose-compress-bluetooth-firewall-6mv4q1_default <container_name>. (2) Tambah extra_hosts: mail.dekirulab.id:10.0.4.2 di compose file agar SSL cert match. Perlu diulang setiap kali container di-recreate.

title: Stalwart SMTP: Username = Short Name, Password via Web UI Only
description: Stalwart v0.15 SMTP auth menggunakan short username (noreply, bukan noreply@dekirulab.id). Password WAJIB dibuat via Web UI — API PATCH /api/account/crypto tidak generate password yang valid untuk SMTP auth meski format hash benar ($6$ sha512crypt).
solution:
1. Buat akun via https://mail.dekirulab.id > Accounts
2. Login SMTP: username = short name saja
3. Jangan gunakan API untuk set password — Web UI only
4. Verifikasi: python3 -c import smtplib; s=smtplib.SMTP_SSL; s.login(short_name, pass)
